## Forward-pipe operator

R now has `|>`

```{r}
rnorm(5000) %>%
  abs %>% `*` (100)  %>%
  matrix(ncol=10)  %>%
  rowMeans %>% round %>% 
  `%%`(9) %>% hist
```

## Tee operator (left)

```{r}
rnorm(5000) %>%
  abs %>% `*` (100)  %>%
  matrix(ncol=10)  %>%
  rowMeans %>% round %>% 
  `%%`(9) %T>% hist %>% sum
```
